input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First data-loading probe ran under the system python3, which lacks numpy (h3_llm_width imports it); reran with the pyenv.py interpreter.
integrity_issues: Before committing the prediction, a data-loading check printed the fresh categories' corpus positive counts (no coder statistic, no draw); disclosed in the script docstring and LOG; the cell list was not changed.

doc_friction.issue: reads sys.argv at import (REPS), so every later script must strip argv before importing; known pattern (ARGS, sys.argv = ...) but undocumented in the README.
seo_title limit (70) only surfaces at check time; one retry.

deviations.why: Landing step 2 (land open research PRs first): the six open research PRs were all opened by sibling sessions within the last hour and marked WIP, so I left them alone rather than touch live work.

goal: Advance a PhD-level programme by one pre-registered step with a real negative result
notes: Pre-registered 7au: four variance floors on the coder-negative cell (plus-two, plus-four, Wilson z=1, plus-two both cells) over 105 cells x 1,000 draws. Floors repair 6 of 8 undercovering weak cells but keep at most 37% of the width gain (negative for two); none qualifies, library default unchanged. Checks run locally: test_llmci.py 40 passed; research/_homepage/build.py ok; check_md_links ok; research_live_links ok; post front matter, links and similarity ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes run.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician designing, pre-registering, running and writing up one simulation milestone

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
